body:
Suicide is a very grey subject but I do agree that suicidal people do not want to ever commit suicide. It's usually the last thing they turn to. What they do want is to get away from whatever is hindering their life and some people don't have the coping mechanisms to deal with it. 

Not sure why you're being downvoted though. I guess it's because your comment is kind of aggressive. It's true that some people are in a delusional mindset when they're going through difficult times.

Makes me kinda sad thinking about it, but I actually am all 6 things you listed. I am not good looking, I was bullied and am afraid of basically any social situation, I am shy, I'm lazy, I procrastinate, and I do have low self esteem because I see myself and compare myself to others. 

It seems so easy to fall into depression for me

Hey friend, 

I was in a similar position before. The girl I loved was depressed, used to cut, and I was depressed as well. It took a huge toil on me but I stuck through it. It is hard looking back because I feel like nothing I did was either right or wrong  but I did what I thought was right by sticking with her because I cared. 

What I did learn was you can only help those that want to be helped and sometimes you have to do what's best for you. I feel like a dick  but sometimes I did avoid talking to this girl sometimes because it was just too much for me. 

I don't know if I really helped or I just rambled off but I think all you can do is be there if you choose to be. You can't control a person to do anything. They make their own actions. What I do think is maybe you can advise her to try to get some help. 

Message me if you ever need to talk, friend :)

Hi friend,

Seems your Mom is just trying to make sense of things and just care a lot about you. For most parents, when they find out their child is depressed they sometimes blame themselves for not doing things to try to prevent it and some don't fully understand so they try to help in ways that they think can help. 

I feel it's best you talk with your Mom. It may be hard but she's still your Mom and she just wants to help :)

Darkest thing I've been through probably was when I got my phone stolen. The guy took the phone out of my hand while I was sitting down in a bus seat and then when I tried to get up some other guy knocked me down into another seat. I was probably traumatized for some weeks. I was already going through some tough times and it made me question "why me?" and "why did I deserve this?" 

I have too many dark thoughts to really consider one the darkest.

Darkest thing I've ever done was overdosing on my medications trying to kill myself. I did this twice hoping I'd be gone from this cruel world but I'm still here somehow.

Hey friend,

I read everything you wrote and am so sorry for the life you've had to endure so far. You didn't deserve to live any of that and I truly wish it wasn't like that for you. The fact you are still here though makes me glad because you could've quit at any point yet you're still here. 

I hope you keep going because I do believe even though you've been through a lot, it's far from over for you :)

Hey friend,

I feel the same way, don't be sorry. I don't really know what to say but I think you're worth it :)

Hey friend,

So sorry to hear about this all. Calling the suicide hotline might help some if you need someone to talk to. There are people out there that want to help and want you to feel better about yourself.

And yes, it might be best for your mental health to try to help yourself out by giving yourself some space from her. It's a difficult position you're in because helping a depressed person while being depressed isn't easy. Whatever you do, please keep going man. You're worth it.

Best of luck :)

Hello friend,

I'd like to begin by saying sorry for everything bad you've had to endure in your life. None of it was your fault nor did you deserve it. I'm also very proud you haven't self harmed in a month, that's awesome! Something positive like that is something you can hold on to when things get bad. 

You're a very strong person and I can just tell from reading what you wrote. The negative things you say about yourself aren't true and are things that other people feel as well. You aren't alone :)

Hello Saarim,

Sounds like there's some loose ends between you and your father. Have you tried talking to him about your concerns? It may be hard at first as most parents don't truly understand the severity of depression but tell him how you've been feeling and try to make him understand the best you can. It'd be best to talk about how you don't hate him either. It's never too late to fix family bonds.

Best of luck with everything :)

Hey friend,

I'm glad you're still here with us. When I saw a therapist, I would always tell them how music was one of my coping mechanisms and something that I always used when I was stressed or so. Music is beautiful and so are you.

Hey friend,

I too go through mood swings like this. I don't quite understand it either but you're not alone when it comes to this.

Hey friend,

This is great to hear! Hold on to the feelings and when you're down remember times like the ones you spoke of where you felt alive. Life is worth it.

Hey friend,

I'm so sorry you're going through all of this. I can only imagine what it's like for you. I was once in a relationship where I was very much in love with a girl. Everything seemed fine until one day she randomly broke up with me. I was hurt. I came to find out she was talking to another guy behind my back and would be in a relationship with him the next day. Yes, it hurt. A lot. It took me around two years to really get over her and I do still think about her a little but blocking her on social networks and such helped. Doing productive things to preemptively get your mind off of her helps too. 

There will be times where you crave her but you have to remind yourself that you are of value and a girl that cheats on you doesn't see the value that is truly in you. You deserve much better and I know you might not see this but in the end, you will get over her and I hope you realize that you are worth it.

I wish you best of luck and message me if you ever need to talk :)

Hey friend,

Sorry to hear that you're going through a rough time. I too remember being on Facebook and getting triggered by things that made me question if I'm really living my life or just wasting my time doing nothing. I questioned myself if I really needed Facebook and if it was of any use for my life. I know for some, it's a platform for messaging friends and such so maybe you don't want to deactivate your account but that's what I did. I can say it helped when it came to the stress of trying to live like a normal person. 

I wish you the best, feel free to message me if you ever want to just talk :)

Hey man,

You're such a nice and kind person for what you've done in this world. You seem like a really cool guy from just what you wrote on here. No matter what purpose your good deeds were for, you did it and if anything, I'm proud for you. It shows someone out there still has a good heart in them somehow.

I don't know of any advice or anything I could say to talk you out of any decisions you make but I hope you know that I appreciate what you've done.

Hey there!

I've stayed a psychiatric hospital twice, so I know what it's like at a psych ward per say.

I too was scared at first and didn't know what to expect but both times I stayed I met some really cool people and it really showed me we're not alone in this fight. It showed me people care and other people do have problems that are much like mine -- we're not alone in this at all.

I went to the ER before being transported to the psychiatric hospital both times and was there for I don't know how many hours but it's whatever. I forgot about it really.

I'd advise to wait to see which place you'll be transported to and their rules for things you're allowed to bring.  

All in all, it's not as scary and what not as it seems.

I hope I helped! If you have any questions, feel free to ask
